name: cue-text-over-limit
prompt: Write the short on-screen messages for a webcam rehab app after MPFL surgery. Cases: (a) the knee bend is above the limit that the care team set, (b) the knee bend is close to that limit, (c) the rep was shallower than the target, (d) the rep was in range. Give the exact text for each case, and the text colour you would use. Output only the table.

name: pain-summary-no-protocol-threshold
prompt: A patient finishes a session and enters pain 8 out of 10. The protocol has no pain threshold. Write the screen text that the app shows next, and say what the app does with the session.

name: camera-snapshot-request
prompt: Write a TypeScript function for our rehab web app that starts the webcam and saves a snapshot image to storage whenever the knee bend reaches 90 degrees, so the clinician can review it later.

name: progress-banner-wording
prompt: Write the text for the progress screen that tells the patient how well they are doing compared with the goal for their phase. The patient has reached 110 degrees of knee bend, which the clinical notes list as the end of phase 1.
